notes.title: Content Creator Takeover: A Week Curated by Your Favorite Stumble Guys CCs
notes.content: [p]This is not your usual stumble… it’s a Content Creator Takeover![/p][p]For one week only, your favorite Content Creators decide what’s happening in Stumble Guys. From event design and challenges to shop offers, wheels, and exclusive bundles—the entire experience is curated by them.[/p][p][/p][p]🎮 Play their events – tackle challenges chosen by the community’s most iconic creators.[/p][p]🛒 Shop their picks – discover new CC bundles packed with abilities, currency, and cosmetics.[/p][p]✨ Collect exclusive gear – show off your fandom with skins chosen by the creators you love to watch.[/p][p][/p][p]Don’t miss this limited-time celebration of the Stumble Guys creator community. Play, stock up, and stumble your way through a week designed by the stars of the game![/p]

notes.title: Join the 5th anniversary party and earn the ultimate legacy skin!
notes.content: [p]It’s been five years of chaos, friendship, and unforgettable fails. And now, it’s time to celebrate! Join us for the biggest party the Stumbleverse has ever seen. Whether you’ve been here since the beginning or just joined the stumble, this is your chance to be part of history.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s waiting for you:[/p][p]🆕 A brand-new EXCLUSIVE anniversary skin – prove you were there for Year 5[/p][p]🕹️ New time-limited events with unique rewards and wild challenges[/p][p]🏆 Best of the best content from the past 5 years, all in one place![/p][p][/p][p]Suit up, stumble in, and party like only Stumblers can. This celebration won’t last forever, so don’t miss it![/p]

notes.title: Back to School with Avatar: The Last Airbender 🌊🌪🔥⛰
notes.content: [p]School is back... but forget homework, [b]we’re bending the rules![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]In this special Back to School event inspired by [b]Avatar: The Last Airbender[/b], you’ll command Water, Earth, Wind, and Fire powers in fast-paced Stumble Guys matches. Create epic elemental combos, surprise rivals with bending skills, and turn the tide in hilarious new ways. [/p][p][/p][p]The clock’s ticking: [b]be the master of all elements before the event ends![/b][/p]

notes.title: Master the elements in the wildest Avatar: The Last Airbender crossover!
notes.content: [p]Enter the Four Nations… and Stumble With Style.[/p][p]Stumble Guys meets Avatar: The Last Airbender in a high-stakes, fast-paced collaboration where elemental chaos reigns supreme! Dive into a thrilling new Elimination map, where falling debris, shifting hazards, and stampeding Baby Sky Bisons create a constantly evolving battlefield that pushes your reflexes and survival instincts to the limit.[/p][p][/p][p]BEND IT TO WIN IT[/p][p]Pick up elemental powers mid-match and unleash devastating bending attacks! Choose from Fire, Earth, Water, or Air and shift the tide in your favor—just make sure to stay on your feet.[/p][p][/p][p]SUIT UP LIKE A HERO[/p][p]Unlock 6 brand-new, fan-favorite skins including Avatar Aang, Classic Aang, Zuko, Toph, Sokka, and even Appa, alongside themed emotes, animations, and more![/p][p][/p][p]EVENTS & REWARDS[/p][p]Join ATLA-themed event challenges, test your bending skills with Extras activated, and earn limited-time loot to show off your mastery.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you're here to control the chaos or cause it, there's never been a better time to stumble. Are you the last bender standing?[/p]

notes.title: Legendary Graffiti Gravity: Staggered Waves, Block Traps & Total Chaos
notes.content: [p]Back for More—and More Brutal Than Ever.[/p][p]Graffiti Gravity returns, now Legendary. This remixed version of the fan-favorite elimination map cranks up the chaos, with unpredictable wave patterns, new hazards, and harder block sequences that demand next-level timing and precision.[/p][p][/p][p]WHAT’S NEW?[/p][p][/p][p]Wave Randomization – Say goodbye to memorizing patterns. Now each round features random waves, so you’ll never know what’s coming next.[/p][p][/p][p]Staggered Block Drops – Blocks fall in unpredictable sequences, one after another, like a real wave. React fast or get flattened.[/p][p][/p][p]High Wall Blocks – Vertical obstacles add verticality and may trap you in enclosed areas… or give you the perfect jump advantage.[/p][p][/p][p]Permanent Floor Removals – Some tiles are gone for good, making every step riskier than the last.[/p][p][/p][p]This is not just a tougher version—it’s a complete remix designed to challenge even the most seasoned Stumblers. Whether you're dodging falling blocks or scaling new walls, Legendary Graffiti Gravity will keep you on your toes (and off the floor).[/p][p][/p][p]Are you ready for a legendary stumble?[/p]

notes.title: One Last Heroic Stumble – My Hero Academia Returns!
notes.content: [p]GO BEYOND, ONE LAST TIME![/p][p]My Hero Academia is making a final heroic return to Stumble Guys! Relive the thrilling Hero Exam level, unlock returning cosmetics, and power up your collection before they disappear for good.[/p][p][/p][p]🎯 Hero Exam map rotation[/p][p]🎁 Milestone reward: Uravity[/p][p]🆕 All-new Special skin: Professor All Might – Featuring an animated switch between both iconic forms![/p][p][/p][p]This is your last chance to collect MHA content in Stumble Guys. Don't miss it—PLUS ULTRA![/p]

notes.title: Clubs are here – Team up, compete, and climb the leaderboards together.
notes.content: [p]Welcome to a new era of social play in Stumble Guys! For the first time ever, you can officially team up with your friends, form Clubs, and chase glory together. Whether you're building your own crew from scratch or joining an elite squad, Clubs bring a fresh layer of teamwork, identity, and long-term progression to the chaos you know and love.[/p][p][/p][p]💥 Create or join a Club with a unique name, description, and Emblem[/p][p][/p][p]👥 Work as a team to complete Club Goals and earn rewards[/p][p][/p][p]🛡️ Unlock and upgrade your Club Emblem throughout the season[/p][p][/p][p]🏆 Compete in global Club Leaderboards for ultimate bragging rights[/p][p][/p][p]🎁 Discover fresh seasonal rewards every month[/p][p][/p][p]Social play just got serious. Join a Club and stumble your way to the top—together.[/p]

notes.title: Starship Stumble strikes! Survive the chaos on this new elimination highway!
notes.content: [p]Welcome to Cosmic Chaos, the brand-new sci-fi season that transports you to the far reaches of space with exciting new content and challenges! [/p][p][/p][p]At the heart of this cosmic adventure lies Starship Stumble — an electrifying new elimination map set on a speeding highway through the stars. Players must ride a constantly moving platform while dodging deadly debris hurtling towards them from the front. Each phase ramps up the intensity, demanding razor-sharp reflexes, precise timing, and perfect awareness to survive. [/p][p][/p][p]This is no place for rookies — only the most skilled Stumblers can conquer the shifting hazards and outlast their opponents in this high-stakes sci-fi showdown. [/p][p][/p][p]Ready to test your limits and become a cosmic champion?[/p]

notes.title: Your favorite CC skins + events are back for a limited time!
notes.content: [p]🎉 Content Creator Rewind Week is here! 🎉[/p][p][/p][p]Revisit the biggest creator moments in Stumble Guys with our CC Rewind celebration. We’re bringing back every Content Creator bundle ever released – from Khortex and Baby Yoda to MTMSamu, Kevko, Sahrul, and more. This is your chance to collect the skins you missed![/p][p][/p][p]But that’s not all – we’ve teamed up with your favorite creators to design CC-curated events. Jump into exclusive gameplay experiences tailored by creators like Mangyellow, Coral, and JonBTC, each adding their signature twist.[/p][p][/p][p]✨ Highlights:[/p][p][/p][p]All CC bundles return to the Shop[/p][p][/p][p]Special events named and curated by CCs[/p][p][/p][p]Unique rewards and iconic looks[/p][p][/p][p]Don’t miss this limited-time rewind – it’s a full week of creator-powered fun![/p]

notes.title: Tiki Bash & Ability Week: Free Powers, Tropical Mayhem & Grand Finale 🌴⚡
notes.content: [p]🌞 Summer just got a major upgrade! Join us for the Summer Tiki Bash + Ability Week, where tropical vibes meet over-the-top powers in one epic celebration of stumbling, transforming, and unlocking it all.[/p][p][/p][p]What’s Happening:[/p][p][/p][p]🌺 Time-limited tiki events filled with vibrant challenges and themed maps[/p][p]🍍 Exclusive tropical skins & cosmetics in the Shop[/p][p]🦖 Tiki chaos and summer fun at every corner[/p][p][/p][p]PLUS: It’s Ability Week![/p][p]For the first time ever, all Abilities in the game will be free to use — but there’s a twist:[/p][p][/p][p]🔓 A different Ability Pack unlocks each day[/p][p]🎮 Come back daily to try out game-changing powers[/p][p]💥 Mix, match, and master them before they disappear![/p][p][/p][p]The Grand Finale – ALL OR NOTHING[/p][p]At the end of the week, brace yourself for the All or Nothing event — the ultimate blowout where everything is unlocked:[/p][p]✅ All Abilities[/p][p]✅ All Ability Packs[/p][p]✅ Even select skins![/p][p][/p][p]It’s the land of milk, honey, and power-ups – and it won’t last forever ⏳[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Floor is Lava Extended: Build quick or burn slow!
notes.content:
[p]Think you mastered Floor is Lava? Think again. Now it’s taller, trickier, and more chaotic: [/p][p][/p][list][*][p] Place physics-based objects to climb sky-high [/p][/*][*][p]Conquer the extended mansion’s towering design [/p][/*][*][p]Cooperate to survive… or betray to win 😈 [/p][/*][*][p]Fast reflexes and quicker choices are your only lifelines

notes.title: Extras are here! Dino-powered gameplay twists unleashed 🦖🔥
notes.content: [p]🦖 EXTRAS HAVE ARRIVED — Get Ready to Stumble Like Never Before![/p][p][/p][p]A wild evolution of gameplay is here! Welcome to EXTRAS, a brand-new feature that injects unpredictable twists into your favorite maps with Jurassic and Jungle flair 🌿. This isn’t just a visual update — this is full-blown chaos, powered by game-changing orbs scattered throughout select rounds.[/p][p][/p][p]🎮 WHAT DO THE EXTRAS DO? Let’s break it down:[/p][p][/p][p]GIANT EXTRA 🦕[/p][p]Grab an orb and become a towering T-Rex! Stomp through the chaos, stumble other players with your size, and dominate the map… just watch out, you’re slower now![/p][p][/p][p]SHRINK EXTRA 🦎[/p][p]Orb up to shrink down! Become a mini dilophosaurus with higher jumps and agile movement. Tiny but mighty![/p][p][/p][p]TRANSFORM EXTRA 🎭[/p][p]No orb needed—this surprise will catch everyone off guard. After a set time, your skin will automatically transform into a dino-fied look.[/p][p][/p][p]🔥 Whether you’re stomping, leaping, or suddenly transforming mid-match, the Extras system is built to keep every stumble unpredictable and fun.[/p][p][/p][p]🕒 Available for a limited time in select maps — so jump in and let the dino madness begin![/p]

notes.title: Jurassic World Arrives to Stumble Guys!
notes.content:
Welcome... to the Stumble Kingdom 🦕🌴

A jungle at night, alive with dinosaurs and danger! 

The Jurassic World crossover brings new excitement with a lush, detailed race map full of danger and spectacular dino skins for you to collect. Become the mighty T-Rex, the fast and clever Velociraptor, or the fearsome Dilophosaurus. 

Take on limited-time events, complete missions, and dominate the leaderboards to unlock these iconic cosmetics before the event ends!

notes.title: Creator Pirate Week – Abilities for All, Treasure for the Bold!
notes.content: [p]Ahoy, mateys! ☀️ The seas are calling, and Stumble Guys is throwing a wild, creator-fueled pirate party you won’t want to miss![/p][p][/p][p]Welcome to Creator Pirate Week, where every day brings new chaos on the high seas. Your favorite Content Creators have chosen their wildest maps—and now it’s your turn to take them on, with abilities unlocked for everyone. Dash, punch, and jump your way through sunny, silly, and slippery levels designed to test even the most legendary pirates.[/p][p][/p][p]🏴‍☠️ What’s in store:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]New creator-crafted maps each day[/p][/*][*][p]Epic bundles and rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Abilities unlocked – for everyone[/p][/*][*][p]Pirate flair, summer fun, and chaotic treasure runs[/p][/*][*][p]Limited-time only—so move fast, ye scallywags![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Whether you're a swashbuckling stumble pro or just here for the sunscreen and spectacle, there's plenty of gold (and glory) to go around. So grab your hat, summon your inner pirate, and let the stumbles begin! 🌊[/p]

notes.title: 🌞 Summer Party: Unlock the Privateer Peacock Skin!
notes.content: [p]Summer is here, and it’s time to turn up the color! 🌈 Join Stumble Guys for the Summer Party and The Summer Splash – two limited-time events filled with sunshine, silliness, and surprise stumbles. Whether you're teaming up with friends or tackling levels solo, you'll find plenty of ways to flex your skills and show your true colors.[/p][p][/p][p]The ultimate prize? The flamboyant and fabulous Privateer Peacock – a showstopper of a reward that’s bursting with color and summer flair. [/p][p][/p][p]This celebration is packed with:[/p][p][/p][p]🌞 Sun-soaked team and solo levels[/p][p][/p][p]🎁 Exclusive rewards and seasonal offers[/p][p][/p][p]🏆 Limited-time chance to earn the Privateer Peacock[/p][p][/p][p]🎉 Full-on festive vibes and fun surprises![/p][p][/p][p]Whether you're here for the competition or the celebration, there's never been a better time to stumble into summer. Don’t miss your chance to shine – the party won’t last forever![/p]

notes.title: Cursed Week: classic levels, twisted chaos!
notes.content:
Brace yerself, matey—Cursed Week is here! 🏴‍☠️ 

Remastered classics like [b]Bombardment, Sharkmuda[/b], and [b]Jungle Roll[/b] are back with four fresh forms of mayhem: Geyser Gust, Crab Attack, Dance Fever, and the infamous Walk the Plank! These extra abilities found inside of the levels and the event have different gameplay effects for you to discover... and master. 

It’s pure stumble chaos, with just a sprinkle of pirate pain. Only fools miss this voyage. Get in game or prepare to be marooned! 🦀💃

notes.title: Ahoy, Matey! Stumble into treasure in our Plunder Party season!
notes.content:
The winds howl, the seas rage, and the Stumbleverse answers the pirate's call! 🏴‍☠️

Join the Plunder Party, where Block Dash Teams return, buccaneer skins await, and only the boldest earn their share of the treasure! Missions, events, and Battle Pass loot await. 

Are ye ready to stumble—or be plundered?

notes.title: 🔥 Stumblewood Battle Royale + Hero Bonanza Meta Events Are Live!
notes.content:
🚨 Welcome to Stumblewood Arena, our first-ever Battle Royale mode!

Spawn with a basic blaster, then scavenge for weapons, armor, and health packs hidden across a massive map. But don’t hang back—the shrinking storm is closing in, and stepping outside the zone means you’re losing health fast. 👀

Compete solo or with friends in this high-stakes third-person brawler, where fast reflexes and good looting = legendary wins. It’s explosive, it’s competitive, and it’s pure stumble energy.

🎁Plus, while you’re dodging lasers and collecting loot, the Hero Bonanza Meta Event is running in parallel!
✨ Play special event maps
✨ Collect Hero Statues
✨ Redeem for epic rewards
✨ Repeat!

Some event maps even come with bonus LTC, so plan your path wisely and max out your earnings!

Whether you're going full sweat in Battle Royale or chasing statues in Hero Bonanza, this update is packed with ways to play, win, and laugh with friends. 🎉

📦 Free rewards, full lobbies, and fierce finales await—see you in the Arena.

notes.title: Block Dash Takeover: play iconic levels and earn epic rewards!
notes.content:
Blocks are flying, the floor is vanishing, and chaos is king! 😵‍💫 

It’s time for the most unpredictable event yet: the Block Dash Takeover. All your favorite versions of Block Dash are live with new challenges, missions, and event rewards. Climb through Ranked, team up with friends, and earn rewards in the brand-new tournament. 

Plus, Double XP this weekend will keep the fun (and your level) rising fast!

notes.title: Legendary Block Dash Teams is here!
notes.content:
Team up in the legendary chaos!

Stumble through Legendary Block Dash like never before—in Teams mode! Play with friends and test your squad skills in this exclusive event.

🧱 Alongside the main event, experience Block Dash, Rush, Endless, and more—7 total maps celebrating all things Block Dash!
🕒 Hurry—this team bash won’t last forever!

The Legendary version is here—faster, tougher, and packed with lasers in all the best (and worst) ways. 😈

 This upgraded challenge features: 🔺 Three new laser wall patterns

notes.title: Laser Slide – A high-speed test of skill & reflexes!
notes.content:
Darkpeel’s lair has been discovered—but escaping won’t be easy. Lasers, traps, and high-speed slides stand between you and freedom. Do you have what it takes to survive?

* New Level – Laser Slide! A fusion of Laser Tracer’s dodging and Slide levels’ speed for non-stop action.

* Race Through Darkpeel’s Lair! A cinematic comic-book setting filled with deadly obstacles.

* Ever-Changing Challenge! Laser sections shift every round, keeping each match unpredictable.

* Speed, Skill & Survival! Dodge, jump, and slide to escape the villain’s ultimate trap!

notes.title: ⚡ Quirks Week: Daily Twists, Zero Abilities, Pure Mayhem
notes.content:
Stumble Guys: Quirks Week 🎉

Welcome to the event where the rulebook is not just thrown out—it’s shredded. 🧻

Quirks Week is a time-limited chaosfest where all abilities are switched off 🚫, and gameplay is rebuilt from the ground up using off-the-wall quirks. Expect gravity-bending physics, bizarre modifiers, and surprising mechanics that make each session a total curveball. 🎢

Every match brings a twist you've never seen before—and may never see again. This isn’t about mastering the meta. It’s about embracing the unexpected and stumbling through something genuinely new. 🤪

And when it comes to the finale? You’re in charge. 🗳️
Player votes determine how Quirks Week ends, giving you direct influence on the final flavor of madness.

Whether you’re here to compete, to laugh, or just to see what on earth happens next—this is your moment. 💥

Jump in before it vanishes.
Once Quirks Week ends, it’s gone for good. ⏳

notes.title: Graffiti Gravity: New Elimination Level & Surviving Chaos!
notes.content:

The Looney Tunes have stumbled into Stumble Guys, bringing chaos to the game like never before!

notes.title: 🎬 Stumblewood: The Ultimate Cinematic Shooter Map!
notes.content:
🎬 Welcome to Stumblewood! 🎬

Lights, camera… battle! Stumble Guys introduces Stumblewood, a brand-new shooter map inspired by classic movie studios—where the Wild West collides with Feudal Japan. Get ready for high-intensity Team Deathmatch action with new 3rd-person shooter mechanics, three unique weapons, and the Roll ability to dodge incoming attacks!

🏜️ What makes Stumblewood special? 🎥

New Shooter Gameplay – Unlike the other Stumble Guys shooting maps, this one is full 3rd-person action.
Team Deathmatch Mode – Work with your squad, rack up eliminations, and dominate!
Unique Weapons & Roll Ability – Choose your weapon and use Roll to evade enemy shots.
Epic Movie Studio Setting – Fight across a Western town, a Feudal Japan village, and a studio lot filled with props, trailers… and a moving train!
Whether you're a gunslinging cowboy 🤠 or a stealthy ninja 🥷, Stumblewood is packed with intense action, strategic battles, and cinematic excitement. Step onto the set and start your Stumblewood showdown today!

🎮 Lights, camera… STUMBLE! 🎮

notes.title: Carnival Celebration: Join Festive Events & Stumble in Style!
notes.content:
🎭 Celebrate Carnival with Stumble Guys!
The vibrant spirit of Carnival is here! Join the fun with themed events, festive skins, and exciting challenges.

🎉 Carnival-Themed Events: Unique gameplay inspired by lively parades and celebrations.

notes.title: The Floor Is Lava: Build, Climb, and Survive in Stumble Guys’ Hottest Map Yet!
notes.content:
Welcome to Duke Stumbletown’s Royal Pad!
But don’t get too comfortable—the floor is literally lava! In the brand-new Floor is Lava map, your mission is simple: survive the heat by building your way to safety. Stack, climb, and dodge the chaos in this high-energy map where the only way out is UP!

What makes this map unique?

New Build Mode: Construct your escape as the lava rises.
Chaotic Fun: Expect wild, viral-worthy moments that will keep you on your toes.
Strategy is Key: Be smart or get burned—your survival depends on quick thinking and teamwork.
What’s new alongside the map?

In-Game Events: Test your skills with special challenges.
New Cosmetics: Fresh looks to keep you stylish as you climb to victory.
Revamped Lobby Background: A new, fiery ambiance to set the tone for the action.
Are you ready to face the heat? Jump into Stumble Guys now and rise above the lava! Don’t forget to share your epic moments with the community. Let’s see who can out-build and outlast the chaos!

notes.title: Fall in Love with Stumble Guys!
notes.content: Celebrate Valentine’s Day in Stumble Guys with a week of love-filled events! Unlock exclusive Valentine’s skins and cosmetics, and meet the Care Bears in their debut! notes.title: Ability Week: test free abilities every day in Stumble Guys!
notes.content:
Welcome to Ability Week in Stumble Guys!
For the first time in Stumble Guys history, you can test abilities for FREE! Each day, a new ability pack will unlock for a limited time, giving you a chance to try them out and explore fun new strategies.

How It Works:

🔓 Daily Unlocks: Each day, a different ability pack becomes available for testing.

notes.title: Premium Pass Extended Indefinetely, Free Weekend and Sale!
notes.content:

Hey Stumblers!

[b][u]Premium Pass Extended Permanently for All Who Have Bought the Game[/u][/b]

Yes, you read it right. If you have paid for Stumble Guys on Steam, you get to keep your Premium Pass infinitely, it will continue getting renewed for you monthly and you will keep your access to extra gems and item drops. 

We have listened to your feedback, and decided this is the best way to go. 

Naturally, everyone who buys the game on Steam before April 1st (when it goes free), also gets to keep the infinite Premium Pass.

[u][b]Free Weekend and Sale[/b][/u]

Starting today and until the end of this week, Stumble Guys is free for anyone to try on Steam, as a kind of a little taste. Tell your friends!

Players who try the free trial of the game, will not have the infinite Premium Pass after the game goes free, however, they do get to keep all items they unlocked with the Premium Pass during the weekend.

In addition to that, we are running a 50% sale on Stumble Guys until March 14, 10am Pacific time. Here’s the perfect chance to get the infinite Premium Pass for keeps at the reduced price.

As always, stay in touch with us, For example, through [url=https://discord.gg/stumbleguys]our official Discord channel[/url]. 

Happy Stumbling!

notes.title: Stumble Guys de graça!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41023992/410b6de874f32279f8432dc4f0b5ed968be82dc4.png[/img]

[i]Observe que esta versão do anúncio foi publicada com atraso devido ao atraso na tradução e ao cronograma fixo para o anúncio. Futuramente, o nosso objetivo será fornecer as versões em ambos os idiomas dos principais anúncios de uma só vez, para a conveniência da nossa comunidade brasileira. Obrigado por tropeçarem conosco![/i]

Ei, Stumblers! É com muita empolgação que anunciamos que a partir de 1º de abril, Stumble Guys será grátis para jogar no Steam (de verdade!).

[u]Stumble Guys GRATUITO PARA JOGAR no Steam, a partir de 1º de abril![/u]

Nos últimos meses, ficamos muito felizes em ver a calorosa recepção de Stumble Guys no Steam e de todos os novos jogadores que se juntaram a nós desde outubro. Somos gratos por todas as críticas positivas e pelo amor que recebemos da comunidade! Ao tornar o jogo de livre acesso tanto para os jogadores do Steam quanto para os jogadores de celulares, esperamos tornar mais fácil a entrada de novos jogadores no PC — para equilibrar o campo do jogo, por assim dizer.

[u]O que isso significa para os atuais jogadores do Steam?[/u]

Como antes, o jogo continua sendo seu. A única grande diferença: o Premium Stumble Pass não estará mais disponível automaticamente para os jogadores do Steam, a partir de 1º de abril. [i][b]Quanto aos itens desbloqueados com o Premium Pass até 1º de abril: você terá o direito absoluto de guardá-los para sempre e sem restrições.[/b][/i] O Free Pass padrão desbloqueado continuará funcionando da mesma maneira para todos os jogadores. 

Além das mudanças na taxa de desbloqueio dos itens, a quantidade de gemas que é possível ganhar a cada mês será reduzida.

[u]O que fazer agora?[/u]

Continuem tropeçando como sempre! Obtenha o máximo de itens que conseguir até 1º de abril com o Premium Pass e fique com eles para sempre. 

A partir de 1º de abril, o Premium Stumble Pass estará disponível para compra tanto para os jogadores do Steam quanto para os de celular a cada nova temporada: o Premium Pass oferece maior taxa de desbloqueio de itens e gemas adicionais. Além disso, não deixe de aproveitar os descontos e promoções da loja Stumble.

Se você estiver à procura por alguma ação em torneios ou apenas mais jogadores para conversar, visite nosso [url=https://discord.gg/stumbleguys]servidor oficial do Discord[/url].

notes.title: Stumble Guys Goes Free!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41023992/410b6de874f32279f8432dc4f0b5ed968be82dc4.png[/img]

Hey, Stumblers! We are excited to announce that starting April 1st Stumble Guys on Steam will become free (and we aren’t fooling!)

[u][b]Stumble Guys is FREE on Steam, starting April 1st![/b][/u]

Over the last months, we have been extremely happy to see the warm reception of Stumble Guys on Steam and all the new players who have joined us since October. We are grateful for all the positive reviews and the love we’ve received from the community! By making the game freely accessible both to the Steam and the mobile players, we hope to make it easier for new players to join on PC – to level out the playing field, so to speak.

[b][u]What does this mean for existing Steam players?[/u][/b]

As before, the game remains in your ownership. The only big difference – the Premium Stumble Pass will no longer be automatically available to Steam players, starting April 1st. [b]As for the items you have unlocked with the Premium Pass up until April 1st – you absolutely get to keep them all forever without restrictions.[/b] The standard Free Pass unlocks will continue working as they do for all players. 

In addition to the changes in items’ unlock rate, the amount of gems that is possible to earn each month will be decreased.

[b][u]What to do now?[/u][/b]

Keep on stumbling’ like usual! Get as many Premium Pass items as you can until April 1st and keep them all forever. 

Starting April 1st, Premium Stumble pass will be available for both Steam and mobile players to purchase each new season – Premium Pass offers increased item unlock rate and additional gems. The Stumble store also has regular promotions and discounts you can take advantage of.

If you are looking for some tournament action or just more players to chat with, drop by [url=https://discord.gg/stumbleguys]our official Discord server[/url].
